public.title: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling
public.description: Each job is [start,end,profit] with integer start strictly less than end and positive profit. Select nonoverlapping jobs for maximum total profit; a job may start exactly when another ends. There are 0 to 500 jobs, times from 0 to 1000000, profits at most 10000.
hints: Sort by finish time and compare skipping versus taking each job.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Binary search counts earlier jobs ending by the new start; prefix DP chooses the best compatible profit. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
